pros-cons.sitebrew:
Create a responsive two-column Pros and Cons card component for Sitebrew in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Organize the component into a responsive grid (grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2) holding two border cards styled with overflow-hidden rounded-lg border bg-card. The Pros card has a top header bar with an emerald background tint (bg-emerald-500/[0.07] text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border-b px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-2), an emerald Check icon (size-3.5, strokeWidth={3}, aria-hidden), and an uppercase title PROS (text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase). Its body is an accessible list (ul with space-y-2 p-4 text-sm) where each li (flex gap-2.5) features an emerald Check icon bullet (mt-1 size-3.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500, aria-hidden) and plain-text item rendering (min-w-0 leading-relaxed). The Cons card mirrors this with a rose header bar (bg-rose-500/[0.07] text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 border-b px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-2), an X icon, title CONS, and accessible list items marked by rose X icons (mt-1 size-3.5 shrink-0 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-500) with plain-text item rendering. Accept editable pros/cons data via props with realistic default items, and display a working preview.
